# Model

- Inherits [`PVInstance`](pvinstance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Model")`

A group of parts that is moved, scaled and measured as one object.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PrimaryPart` | `BasePart?` | — | read/write | The part that the model's pivot follows. When the model is cloned, the copy's `PrimaryPart` refers to the copied part. |
| `Scale` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The size of this model relative to the size it was built at. Setting it resizes every part under the model and moves each part about the model's pivot, so the model grows or shrinks in place. Must be greater than 0.<br><br>The value is absolute: setting 2 twice leaves the model at twice its built size, and setting 1 restores it. Parts added to the model later are not scaled, so parent a part before you scale. A scaled model costs the same to draw and simulate as an unscaled one. |
| `StreamingMode` | `Enum.StreamingMode` | `Enum.StreamingMode.Nonatomic` | read/write | How this model is loaded and unloaded when the world streams. `Nonatomic`, the default, loads each part separately by its own position. `Atomic` loads and unloads the whole model as one unit. `Persistent` keeps the model loaded at all times.<br><br>The value is read when the world is divided for streaming. Changing it at run time has no effect until the world is built again. |

## Methods

### `GetExtentsSize(): vector`

Returns the size, in meters, of the smallest box that contains every part in this model.
